name: FW1
status: FORWARD CANDIDATE — declared 2026-11-06. The forward clock starts at the first frozen daily record that carries FW1 (after VPS v1.1 is installed); no earlier day is ever used to judge it. Any change = FW2, with its own clock; days already used to judge FW1 are never reused to judge FW2.
why: Stage 4: averaging graded families flattened the score (85% Neutral) and trend carried almost all of the edge. FW1 is trend-led with a fixed base and counted confirmations/warnings instead of an average.

strongUp.rule: close > SMA20 > SMA50, SMA20 rising over 5 bars, E1 >= +6

up.rule: close > SMA20 > SMA50, SMA20 rising over 5 bars

down.rule: close < SMA20 < SMA50, SMA20 falling over 5 bars

strongDown.rule: close < SMA20 < SMA50, SMA20 falling over 5 bars, E1 <= -6

perpFroth.rule: E3a score <= -3 (premium in its top percentiles)

entry.required: E1 bars fresh (base) — otherwise withheld; each confirmation/warning only counts when its family is active
entry.note: A failed auction low with Fear & Greed <= 25 scores +4 in total (+2 auction confirmation, +2 capitulation warning), by design.

strongUp.rule: close > SMA200, SMA200 rising over 20 bars, T3 >= +6

up.rule: close > SMA200, SMA200 rising over 20 bars

down.rule: close < SMA200, SMA200 falling over 20 bars

strongDown.rule: close < SMA200, SMA200 falling over 20 bars, T3 <= -6

tendency.notUsed: T2 (LTH): both signs failed Stage 4 and its direction is unknown
